source: Built-in catalog: regional planting charts for cool-spring, continental and Atlantic climates, plus added crops
format: Ranges are days from the last spring frost (L) or first fall frost (F).
details_source: Growing details from open-garden-data (https://github.com/thedude459/open-garden-data, CC0, fd216ce)

crops.name: Potato
crops.notes: Plant seed potatoes. Early varieties about 70 days, main crop about 110.

crops.name: Daikon radish
crops.notes: Sow in late summer for a fall harvest. Spring sowings tend to bolt.

crops.name: Napa cabbage
crops.notes: Late-summer sowings head best. Spring plantings can bolt as days lengthen.

crops.name: Watermelon
crops.notes: Needs heat and space; small "icebox" types such as Sugar Baby suit shorter seasons. Ripe when the spot resting on the ground turns creamy yellow and the nearest tendril dries.

crops.name: Sweet potato
crops.notes: Grown from slips (rooted sprouts) rather than seed; indoor start here means sprouting slips from a stored root. Needs warm soil and a long season. Too much nitrogen gives leaves instead of roots. Cure the roots somewhere warm for a week or two before storing.
